readerCopy.body: One practical experiment may give shape to a hunch you have only been able to imagine. When Neptune sextiles the North Node, a creative idea, compassionate goal, or intuitive pull can become specific enough to evaluate once you give it something concrete to work through. Make the prototype, schedule the meeting, or price the project. You do not need absolute certainty before beginning. You just need one action that shows you what the idea can support and what deserves more of your time.
